content: Ngudda God! Bininj nawu birrikang kubolkbubuyika wanjh birrimwam bu kabirribolkdjirdmang ngudda ke kunbolk. Bedda wanjh birrirurrkwarrewong ngudda ke Temple manrurrkdjamun, dja birrirurrkbakkabakkeng kunrurrk rowk kore kukadje Jerusalem.
Bindibom dja bindikukbawong birriwern nawu ngundimarnedurrkmirri bininj ba mayhmayh kabirrikanjngun kore kabirrikukyo. Mayh nawu nabang kabenkukkanjngun bininj nawu ngundiwoybukwong.

Nahni birribang bininj wanjh bindikurlbawarrhkeng bedberre nawu bininj ke yiman kukku birridjalboyakarrbuni kore kuberrkkah kukadje Jerusalem. Minj nangale bininj kahdjaldarrkid bu kabenkukdudjeng nawu birridowerrinj.
Bonj, wanjh ngandiwarrewan bininj nawu kabirrihni kubolkbuyika darnkih. Bedda wanjh ngandikukyolyolme dja ngandidjekmiwon ngadberre.
Ngudda nawu Yawey, ngundidjawan bu yiddok munguyh kandjaldung? Yiddok yidjalkirn kunkimuk duninjh, yiman manbu manbirlukimuk?
Wardi yibendu bininj nawu birrikang kubolkbubuyika bu nawu ngundidjalwarnyak ngudda. Kumekbe birriwern bininj kore kubolkbubuyika minj ngundingeykayhme.
Bedda wanjh bindibom bininj nawu Jacob benkebmawahmeng, dja birribolkwarrewarrewong kunred bedberre.
Ngadberre mawahmawah birribakkeng ke mankarre, dja yuwn bu kandung ngad nawu bolkkime ngarrihni. Ngarridjare ngudda bu werrkwerrk kankongibun ngadberre, dja bolkkime ngarriwernhkangewarre duninjh.
O God nawu kanngehke, ngundidjawan kanbidyikarrmen bolkkime ba bu birriwern bininj ngundingeyburlume. Kanbebkemen kore kunyidkenh, dja mak kanmarnebengmidjda kore ngudda kunngey dorrengh.

Dja bu burrkyak, wanjh bininj nawu kubolkbubuyikabeh wardi kabirriyime, “Ngayh! Nakka God bedberre wanjh baleh wam?” Mah, ngarridjare ngundikurdunan bu yibenbun bininj nawu kubolkbubuyikabeh nawu bindikurlbayakwong bininj nawu ngundimarnedurrkmirri.

Yibenbekkabekka bininj nawu kabirribongdi bu kabirridjalkayhme kunnjilngwarre dorrengh. Nawu birriwarre bininj bindiwarrewam dja kaluk kabindibun kabindikukkurrme, wanjh yibenngehkemen kundulkarre ke dorrengh.
Ngudda nawu yiwohrnan rowk, birrimekbe bininj ngundiwirrihmeng bu kunwarre ngundimarneyimeng, wanjh ngarridjare ngudda yibenbun wernkih duninjh bu kunmekbekenh.

Wanjh ngad nawu bininj ke, yiman kanmirndenahnan yiman kayime sheep kore kurralkmak ke, wanjh ngundidjalmanjbun munguyh munguyh. Dja nawu mawahmawah ngadberre, dja bedmanwali bu kabindikebmawahme warridj, wanjh ngundidjalburlume warridj munguyh munguyh.
